svg.title: Hearthboard platform overview
svg.desc: Two Flutter codebases: a mobile client for Android and iOS with home-screen widgets, and a separate Android TV client for ambient split-flap display. Both share backend services for auth, messaging, pairing and subscriptions. The TV app is engineered but not publicly released.
svg.text: Hearth: mobile widgets plus an unreleased Android TV display
Short split-flap messages to friends on the phone; optional living-room ambient board after QR pairing.
SHARED PRODUCT IDEAS
Compose a short uppercase message, friends feed and partner board, reactions and themes
Cloud auth and profiles, tiered send limits, TV pairing records, push when a message arrives
MOBILE FLUTTER CLIENT, LIVE ON GOOGLE PLAY
Android phone / tablet
iOS (same app)
Home-screen widget: pre-rendered board card per theme
Scan QR or enter code to claim a TV, manage paired sets
Background post queue, optimistic local-first sync
Workmanager refresh, FCM-driven widget updates
Subscriptions via in-app purchase bridges
Provider view models, portrait shell navigation
About 61,200 lines of Dart under lib/
ANDROID TV FLUTTER FORK, NOT PUBLICLY RELEASED
Android TV, leanback
Engineering complete, no store listing in this showcase
Shows QR for phone to claim, landscape ambient loop
D-pad focus wrappers, owner header and board carousel
Sleep / empty states, split-flap motion and sound
Rewarded and banner ads SDK on TV build
Shared repositories with mobile where paths align
About 39,500 lines of Dart under lib/
191 shared source paths, 53 byte-identical between forks
REMOTE SERVICES (BOTH CLIENTS)
Firebase Auth, Firestore, Storage, Cloud Messaging, Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, serverless push on new messages, image CDN uploads for widget previews
